t: Versatile, water-resistant worklight suitable for renovations or DIY projects. Delivers a bright 1000lm output, with a 6500K colour temperature, making it ideal for both indoor and outdoor use. Portable light, with adjustable head, allows the user to direct light exactly where required. Built with an IP65 rating, it’s tough enough to withstand the elements, ensuring reliable performance in any setting. Features include surface mounted diode (SMD), plug in and plug out light settings, 28 x LED lights and a 30m beam distance.
b: Worklight can be Mounted to a Tripod
